g.text: Classifier bars: 95% Monte Carlo intervals. Mean bars: +/-1 Monte Carlo standard error.
Forecasts extend the current market before reset (market ages T versus 16). No field data.
No observed classification errors at large replication horizons imply an upper bound, not zero true risk.
